policy.pass_definition: Exact requested scalar and Taiwan Traditional topology agree with current CNS mapping/stroke structure; directly recognizable at native, 128, 64, and 32 px; ink clears the grid; no stray thorn, wrong hook, or missing/extra semantic stroke.
policy.reject_definition: Any uncertainty, simplified/incompatible variant, missing/extra semantic component, topology-changing join, wrong hook, size unreadability, grid contact, stray ink, or thorn is REJECT.
policy.raster_limit: A final raster establishes visible topology but cannot prove the temporal act of writing each stroke.
policy.vectorization_limit: PASS permits controlled tracing of isolated authored dark ink only; grid lines, background variation, antialias halos, and CNS outlines are forbidden geometry.

legal_small_components.finding: visible intended short dot stroke in the upper 䍃 cluster; adjacent intended short strokes measure 117 and 141 px; not debris

authority.provider: Ministry of Digital Affairs, Taiwan, CNS11643 Chinese Standard Interchange Code Full Character Database

visual_copybook.usage: independently rasterized topology comparison only; no outline, coordinate, or trace enters the generated glyph

views: generated cell beside independently rasterized CNS TW-Kai
method.grid_detection: Five long light-gray line groups per axis were projection-detected. Clearance is minimum distance from L<100 ink to a grid-line centre.
method.stray_component_detection: L<100 pixels were grouped by 8-connectivity. The smallest component is 81 px; the sole component below 100 px was visually located as an intended 䍃 dot in 遙.
artifact_review: Taiwan Traditional topology and CNS stroke structure
grid contact and stray dark components
method.background_note: Near-white L>=245 standard deviation ranges from 1.17 to 1.41; background normalization remains mandatory before tracing.
